name: Echo CS-352
blurb: A 34 cc homeowner saw: 12″, 14″ and 16″ bars on 3/8″ low-profile chain, .050″ gauge, 45–57 drive links per Echo's own chart.
intro: The Echo CS-352 is a 34 cc homeowner saw on 3/8″ low-profile .050″ chain. Echo's specification table gives it a 16″ bar, and Echo's Bars and Chains chart lists two shorter bars for it too: 12″ (12A0CD3745C, 45 drive links of 91PX45CQ) and 14″ (14A0CD3752C, 52 drive links of 91PX52CQ). All three are in the table below. The 14″ and 16″ loops are also sold as 3-packs, 91PX52CQ-3 and 91PX57CQ-3.
